Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Primary state variable; updated strictly once per timestep via cell volume summation

Physical_Definition: Total grounded ice mass at initial reference state t=0
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Fixed baseline; subtracted once in residual formula

Physical_Definition: Cumulative surface mass balance added to grounded ice sheet
Sign_Convention: Positive for net accumulation; negative for ablation
Integration_Type: Time-integrated discrete sum of rho_i * W * a_ice * dx
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Tracks cumulative climate input; added to grounded mass budget

Physical_Definition: Cumulative advective ice mass discharged across grounding line
Integration_Type: Time-integrated sum of rho_i * Q_GL * dt
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Tracks mass crossing physical grounding line into ocean/shelf; counted once per timestep

Physical_Definition: Volumetric ice flux crossing grounding line [W_GL * q_GL]
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Converted to mass via multiplication by rho_i; never summed directly with mass

Physical_Definition: Volumetric ice flux per unit width at grounding line
Integration_Type: Instantaneous flux at flotation thickness H_GL
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Evaluated from Schoof boundary condition; multiplied by W_GL to yield Q_GL

Physical_Definition: Constant bulk density of glacier ice
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Strictly converts all volumetric fluxes and cell volumes to mass units

Physical_Definition: Net mass transfer across moving boundary due to grounding-line migration
Sign_Convention: Positive during advance; negative during retreat
Integration_Type: Time-integrated sum of rho_i * W_GL * H_GL * (dx_GL/dt) * dt
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Captures Reynolds transport boundary flux; NEVER subtracted from prognostic state

Physical_Definition: Cumulative mass converted from grounded to floating during retreat
Integration_Type: Discrete sum of ungrounded cell mass when g -> g-1
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Decomposed retreat component of M_boundary; strictly diagnostic post-processing audit

Physical_Definition: Cumulative mass converted from floating to grounded during advance
Integration_Type: Discrete sum of newly grounded cell mass when g -> g+1
Double_Count_Prevention_Role: Decomposed advance component of M_boundary; strictly diagnostic post-processing audit

Physical_Definition: Absolute discrepancy in discrete Reynolds transport mass budget
